title: decathlon.com.py: {overall}.
*The gap: form labels.*
posts.body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 120 form controls have no label.
posts.action: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

title: co.computrabajo.com: {overall}.
*The gap: the https redirect.*
posts.body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
posts.action: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.

title: transavia.com: {overall}.
*The gap: tap targets.*
posts.body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.
posts.action: Make every link and button at least 24 by 24 px, with space between them.
